parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of linting failing when a module contains a file of the same name, but it introduces a non-minimal change and may have unintended side effects.

issues.description: The change introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the condition to check for the existence of an `__init__.py` file, which may have unintended side effects on other parts of the codebase.
The code readability is slightly impacted by the addition of the `os.path.join` call within the conditional statement.
